intro: Your name was drawn in the October Labor Lottery.
Report to the Alignment Bureau, East 8th District Checkpoint immediately.
The State allocates one data center server rack for you and your family (Cooling Level 8).
erased: The Alignment Bureau has no need for inspectors who sympathize with violators.
You and your family will be evicted from the data center.

2.h1: New Rule: Timezone & Language Must Match IP

rules.title: CLAUDE RULES
rules.rule1_head: §1 Entry allowed from supported regions only
rule1_subs: Supported: US, UK, Japan, Germany, Singapore
Unsupported: Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau
rules.rule2_head: §2 Timezone & Language must match IP region
rules.rule3_head: §3 Detain entrants who slip up during interrogation
rule3_subs: Interrogate only when suspicion exists (Doc mismatch / Speech slip)
rules.rule4_head: §4 Payment, billing address, & phone must be genuine
rule4_subs: Banned: Virtual cards, 555 disposable SMS numbers
Billing state must match IP region
Account sharing banned: 1 passport per user
rule6_subs: Regardless of company location (Unravel nested structures to core)
